sections.title: Liquid aquafaba for small batches
sections.html: Liquid VERY AQUAFABA is ready to pour and whip, making it suited to small-batch meringue production in pastry kitchens and boutique bakeries. The product arrives in a 1 L Tetrapak that can be stored at ambient temperature until opened. Use the dose shown in the key figures on this page, chill the aquafaba as recommended, then whip to stiff peaks following the recipe guidelines. The liquid delivers consistent foam structure and reliable volume, supporting precise shaping and baking. Samples and technical sheets are provided on request to facilitate formulation testing.

sections.title: Powder format
sections.html: Powder VERY AQUAFABA is supplied in a compact 200 g pouch that occupies minimal storage space, making it a practical choice for facilities where shelf footprint matters. The product can be measured precisely according to the dose shown in the key figures on this page, delivering reproducible foam performance for larger production runs. Because the powder is shelf-stable before opening, it can be stocked ahead of seasonal peaks; after opening, see the technical sheet. For industrial customers who require continuous supply, the liquid is also available in a 1 T IBC. Technical sheets and free samples are provided on request to support formulation development.

sections.title: When to use liquid or powder aquafaba for meringues
sections.html:
The choice between liquid and powder aquafaba for meringues depends on your production context and requirements.

  • For pastry chefs and bakeries making small batches of meringues, the liquid format is convenient.
  • For testing new meringue flavours in small quantities, the liquid format allows for easy adjustment of batch sizes.
  • When producing meringues daily in limited quantities, the liquid format is a good fit.
  • Seasonal peaks in meringue demand can be managed with the powder format. Its 200 g pouches are compact and easy to store, allowing you to stock up for busy periods.
  • For industrial production lines, the liquid format is available in a 1 T IBC container, providing a continuous supply for high volume operations, while the powder format enables precise measuring for large-scale batches.
  • If you prepare meringue bases in advance, the powder format is suitable. Its 200 g pouches allow for accurate dosing and storage of pre-measured quantities.

sections.title: Meringue production with VERY AQUAFABA
sections.html:
VERY AQUAFABA gives consistent results in meringue production and is safer than raw egg white. The liquid, in a 1 L Tetrapak, is ready to pour and whip and suits small batches; the powder, in a 200 g pouch, is easy to store and measure and suits larger quantities. For industrial buyers the liquid is available in a 1 T IBC on request.

The meringue-making process involves gradually adding sugar to the whipped aquafaba, creating a stable foam. Piping the mixture into desired shapes and slow drying at low oven temperatures results in light, crisp meringues. Proper storage is essential: meringues should be kept in airtight containers away from humidity to maintain their texture. For industrial batches, maintaining a consistent aquafaba concentration is crucial for reproducible foam performance.

VERY AQUAFABA's technical sheets provide detailed instructions for consistent results, and free samples are available so you can test the product against your own specifications.

faq.q: How do I decide between liquid and powder for meringue?
faq.a: The decision depends on your production scale and storage considerations. The liquid format is ready to use and suits small batches, while the powder format is easy to store and measure, making it suitable for large-scale production.

faq.q: Can I use the liquid format for large batches?
faq.a: Yes. For large volumes the liquid is available in a 1 T IBC on request. The powder remains the easier format to store and measure in bulk.

faq.q: What are the benefits of the powder format for large batches?
faq.a: The powder format offers practical advantages for large-scale production, such as efficient storage and precise measuring. It is designed for industrial kitchens and factories. Technical sheets and free samples are available on request.

faq.q: Can I use the liquid format directly from the pack for meringue?
faq.a: Yes, the liquid format is ready to pour and whip, making it a convenient choice for meringue production. Simply follow the recipe instructions for the desired application.

sections.title: Liquid aquafaba for baking
sections.html:
The liquid format arrives ready to pour and ready to whip, offering a plant-based egg-white replacement that delivers foaming, binding and moisture-retention in cakes, cookies, doughs and sponges. It is shelf-stable before opening and can be stored at ambient temperature, making logistics simple for small-scale production. For aerated batters the liquid is chilled and whipped to achieve reliable foam, as described in the guide.

This solution fits bakeries, pastry kitchens and food manufacturers that value ease of use, quick handling and a streamlined workflow. It provides reproducible results and a safer alternative to raw egg white.

sections.title: Powder
sections.html:
The powder format is supplied in a compact pouch that is shelf-stable before opening and easy to store in ambient conditions. It is measured according to the dose shown in the key figures on this page, following the technical sheet, for accurate and reproducible dosing for high-volume production. The plant-based egg-white replacement provides foaming, emulsifying and binding performance comparable to egg whites.

This option is well suited to professional kitchens, bakeries and factories that require consistent results and efficient logistics. The compact packaging reduces storage space and simplifies inventory management, while the precise dosing supports reliable formulation at scale.

sections.title: When to use liquid or powder aquafaba in baking
sections.html:
The format you choose depends on your production context.

  • For small bakeries and kitchens, the liquid format is a practical choice for its ready-to-use convenience and whipping performance.
  • In larger-scale operations, the powder format allows precise measurement and efficient storage.
  • When creating new recipes or experimenting with flavours, the liquid format is a practical choice for small batches.
  • For factories and industrial bakeries, the powder format suits high-volume production and offers precise dosing.
  • For seasonal peaks, the powder in 200 g pouches can be stocked ahead; for continuous industrial volumes, the liquid is available in a 1 T IBC.
  • If storage space is limited, the powder format is compact and easy to store.

sections.title: The professional choice for baking
sections.html:
VERY AQUAFABA is a plant-based egg-white replacement for cakes, cookies, doughs and sponges. Its foaming and emulsifying properties deliver aeration, binding and moisture retention, giving reproducible results.

The liquid format arrives ready to pour and to whip. It is suited to small batches where quick handling and reliable foam are required.

The powder format is supplied in a compact pouch, easy to store and to measure. It is prepared according to the technical sheet, providing precise dosing for high-volume production.

In aerated batters, the liquid is chilled and whipped before being folded in. When replacing whole eggs, reduce other liquids slightly or increase dry ingredients to keep the batter consistency, as in the guide.

VERY AQUAFABA offers a safer alternative to raw egg white. The liquid is available in a 1 L Tetrapak or, on request, in a 1 T IBC; the powder in a 200 g pouch. Technical sheets and free samples are provided on request.

faq.q: How do I decide between liquid and powder aquafaba for baking?
faq.a: The choice depends on your baking scale and your storage and logistics needs. The liquid format is ready to pour and to whip, making it convenient for small-scale baking. The powder format offers precise measuring and efficient storage, making it practical for large-scale production.

faq.q: What are the benefits of using liquid aquafaba for baking?
faq.a: The liquid format is ready to use, making it convenient for small-scale baking. It whips and emulsifies well, providing a reliable alternative to egg whites or whole eggs in recipes. Chilling the liquid before whipping helps achieve reliable foam volume in aerated applications.

faq.q: How does the powder format benefit large-scale baking operations?
faq.a: The powder format is prepared according to the technical sheet, for precise dosing. This is essential for large-scale baking operations, where accuracy and consistency are critical.

faq.q: Can I use aquafaba in any baking recipe?
faq.a: Aquafaba can replace whole eggs or egg whites in many traditional bakery recipes. The key is to maintain the same batter consistency by slightly adjusting other liquids or dry ingredients. When replacing only egg whites, no further adjustments are usually needed.
